messages.author: 4c80175465ef625b
messages.subject: 'Packages reordered' warning message
parts:
Hi,

I would like to extract expression values from HuEx-1_0-st-v2 CEL
files. I copied the instructions from
http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/human-exon-array-analysis
into a script, and executed the script. It seemed to go well. However,
R gave me this warning message:
Warning message:
In fcn(...) : Packages reordered in search path: package:affy

I tried loading affy before loading aroma.affymetrix, and then I
didn't get any warnings.

Is there something to worry about, or is it just a message telling me
that aroma.affymetrix reorders the search path?

Many thanks,
Seagull.

messages.author: 1ff63ac4948de366
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] 'Packages reordered' warning message
parts:
Hi Seagull.

Nothing to worry about there. As you may know, packages loaded most
recently last become first on the search path. But, aroma.affymetrix
prefers to have a bit of control over this and just gives mention when
it does.

Cheers,
Mark
